$comment: Architecture budgets for the 2026-11-07 SOLID remediation program. Measured by scripts/architecture-budget.mjs. `max` is the ceiling enforced by `npm run architecture:check`; `target` is the program-end value. Budgets were tightened to the achieved end state at program close (2026-11-07) so the remediation cannot silently regress. Audit numbers come from research/docs/2026-11-07-solid-principles-audit.md; measured baselines and deviations are recorded in docs/solid-remediation-decisions.md.
